note: NOT a pure knob diff over the base. The stacked-pairs BASE is a NON-pinned fade+rise reveal (each .pair rises+fades in-view, two scrub:true triggers, owns_pin:false). This variant keeps the SAME text-left / render-right composition and the SAME ONE-Lenis engine, but swaps the reveal MOTION MODEL: each .pair is PINNED and its reveal is SCRUBBED over a long pinned scroll (controlled SAISEI timing) and the render is revealed by a CLIP-PATH WIPE (a new clip phase the base does not have). Per CONTRACT, a new pin + a new clip phase is a different motion model, not a base data knob, so this variant ships its OWN self-contained variant.lab.html carrying the pinned-slice engine (params.json documents the mode + axis; there is no shared base engine parameterized over `mode`). The ONLY difference from slice-lr is the clip axis. Byte-faithful to frs13-stacked-slice-td.html (owner-approved, gate-clean).

engine.model: pinned SAISEI slice reveal — each .pair is pinned and scrubbed; text first -> clear pause -> render clip-wipes open slowly -> holds -> pin releases. SAME composition + SAME Lenis engine as the base; DIFFERENT reveal motion model (base = non-pinned fade+rise).
engine.pin: ScrollTrigger.create({ trigger:sec, start:'top top', end:'+='+Math.round(innerHeight*1.35), pin:true, pinSpacing:true, scrub:1, onUpdate:self=>render(self.progress) }) + render(0) at init
engine.phaseMap: 0.00->0.20 TEXT reveal (bar+idx+title+sub air stagger);  ~0.26->0.46 PAUSE (text alone, render fully hidden);  0.46->0.96 RENDER clip-wipes open (air-eased);  0.96->1.00 settled hold before pin release
engine.clipAxis: TOP->DOWN — clip the BOTTOM: inset(0 0 B% 0), B 100->0, so the visible region starts at the TOP edge and grows DOWNWARD. Do NOT invert (do not clip the top).
engine.kenBurns: monotonic img scale 1.05 -> 1.12 across the whole pinned p (no reset, image-only)
engine.shared: text-left ~38% / render-right ~62% (84vh, rounded-left frame, ~2cm gap, far-left bronze rule, index eyebrow + Fraunces italic-bronze heading + sub, tag bottom-right); ONE Lenis lerp:0.1 smoothWheel -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update, lagSmoothing(0); transform/opacity/clip-path only; no WebGL; no mix-blend/backdrop over the scrubbed surface; no video.currentTime; reduced-motion / <=820px -> static legible stack
